issue.title: Agents working outside their role scope bypass gateway only at push time

acceptance_criteria.description: When an agent push is rejected for role restrictions, the error message includes specific git reset HEAD~1 remediation steps and lists the allowed files separately from blocked files
A push-recovery.md rule file exists in sandbox/agent-config/rules/ with step-by-step recovery instructions
egg-orch push --scope-filter successfully strips out-of-scope files and pushes only allowed ones, and handles the all-filtered edge case gracefully

phases.name: Implement

tasks.description: CODER: In gateway/gateway.py:929-937, enrich the push-denied error for agent-role restrictions to include remediation steps — git reset HEAD~1, re-add allowed files, re-commit. Add remediation and allowed_patterns keys to details dict. Preserve existing blocked_files.
tasks.notes: Enriched error includes remediation string, allowed_patterns list, and preserves blocked_files. Also imports get_agent_pattern for pattern lookup.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Error response details include remediation string with git recovery commands and allowed_patterns list, alongside existing blocked_files

tasks.description: CODER: Add egg-orch push --scope-filter subcommand that reads EGG_AGENT_FILE_PATTERNS env var, filters commit to allowed files only, and pushes. Handle all-filtered edge case with clear error message.
tasks.notes: Added cli_push.py with _filter_files supporting allowed, blocked, and block_exempt patterns. Uses merge-base for multi-commit handling. Integrated into orch_cli.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Command strips out-of-scope files and pushes allowed ones; exits cleanly when no files remain

tasks.description: DOCUMENTER: Update role-scope enforcement documentation across agent-development.md, agent-roles.md, and concurrent-execution.md
tasks.notes: Restored block_exempt_patterns docs, expanded SDK tool interception section, updated push detection docs.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Documentation accurately describes the enriched error format, scope-filter command, and block_exempt_patterns

tasks.description: TESTER: Update gateway tests to verify enriched error message includes remediation and allowed_patterns in details, and preserves blocked_files structure
tasks.notes: Added test_push_error_enrichment.py and tests/sandbox/test_cli_push.py covering enriched error format, block_exempt support, and multi-commit handling.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tests pass and validate new response format including remediation content and allowed_patterns

review_feedback: NACK v1 (reviewer_code): (1) cli_push.py _filter_files does not handle block_exempt_patterns, (2) concurrent_executor.py does not include block_exempt in EGG_AGENT_FILE_PATTERNS, (3) --scope-filter uses HEAD~1 instead of merge-base for multi-commit handling
NACK v2 (tester): Test assertions updated to match multi-commit and block_exempt support in v2
